text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.1412 for the Software Engineer (Front-end) position. The strongest evidence of their qualifications includes experience with "React", "Node.js", and "AWS". Key gaps include missing must-have requirements such as typescript, prototyping tools, redux, sass/css, responsive/adaptive design, and animation library. Despite the low fit and missing must-have skills, this application has been escalated for further review.
